text:
sarah_ops: FYI procurement flagged a split on PO PO-82400 (H100 batch). Vendor reporting 28/36 clear, 8 units on hold for customs + one FW mismatch SKU. Need to decide loaners vs express vs credit.

michael_vendor: Apologies for the churn. Primary AWB: AWB-EU1000 -> 28 units ETA 2024-11-07 AMS dock. Remaining 8 stuck in FRA pending ECCN + firmware reconciliation. We can: 1) ship 8 express (ETA 11-09) for +$4k, 2) provide 6 loaners now and 2 later, or 3) take a 30% credit on the delayed 8.

julia_logistics: If express chosen we need WH pre-alert and broker uplift. Express needs payment change today to meet 11-09. Loaners route needs staging reservation and manifests.

owen_sre: Loaners ok if firmware parity and serials. We need to run quick hotplug + token microbench. Also ask vendor to send a minimal fw-diff report so we can validate KV cache compatibility.

nina_finance: Show $/unit surcharge and net cost after vendor goodwill. We'll weigh versus incremental Dedicated burst cost.

michael_vendor: Surcharge $4k total (~$500/unit). Vendor offers to pick up 50% of surcharge if Redwood prefers credit instead: reduce credit to 15% and pay half surcharge, or Redwood pays full surcharge and vendor reduces credit to 5%.

sarah_ops: Preference = hybrid: take 6 loaners immediately, expedite 2 via express with 50/50 surcharge split, accept 15% credit on the delayed line. This minimizes pool disruption.

michael_vendor: We can do that. Loaners: H100-80C fw=3.2.1 serials included; LOAN-AWB-220 -> ETA 2024-11-06 AMS. Express AWB = AWB-EXP-221 -> ETA 2024-11-09. Draft amendment inbound.

julia_logistics: I'll reserve 6 staging slots at AMS depot for LOAN-AWB-220 and book express broker for AWB-EXP-221 once amendment signed. Need prepaid return labels for RMA routing to AMS.

owen_sre: Acceptance checks: boot, nvidia-smi, ECC=0, run micro-token 1024 tokens >=1100 qps. If fail -> immediate RMA. Please provide serials in advance to pre-seed asset DB.

michael_vendor: Will upload serial manifest and quick-burn logs to the RMA portal. Vendor policy: prepaid returns for DOA within 30 days; turnaround target 10 business days. For firmware-caused returns we offer depot-swap or invoice credit - Redwood to confirm preference.

rma_bot: [RMA-CREATE] RMA ID RMA-20241107-042 created for PO-82400 delayed tranche. Status=ACTION_REQUIRED. Attach photos/logs within 48h.

nina_finance: Approve 50/50 surcharge split + 15% credit on delayed line pending signed amendment and invoice terms. CC finance on amendment please.

sarah_ops: Action list: 1) @michael_vendor post amendment + manifests; 2) @julia_logistics reserve AMS slots & insurance; 3) @owen_sre run acceptance on loaners; 4) @nina_finance sign off on invoice terms. I'll sign amendment once it's in.

michael_vendor: Amendment posted: https://vendor-share.example.com/amend/PO-82400. Uploading manifests now. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

rma_bot: [RMA-UPDATE] RMA-20241107-042 status -> PRE-FLIGHT_PENDING (awaiting attachments).

owen_sre: Quick acceptance script (will run on each host):

#!/bin/bash
NODE=$1
ssh root@$NODE "nvidia-smi -L && nvidia-smi -q | grep -E 'Product|Driver Version|ECC'"
docker run --rm token-bench:latest --tokens 1024 --min-qps 1100

julia_logistics: Noted, will ping customs broker for express uplift. Posting ETA updates in thread.

sarah_ops: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with AWB numbers and RMA attachments.
